summary.content:
Today's selection covers 64 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 42 on Artificial Intelligence and 9 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI changes deal with US military after backlash
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: UH Cancer Center data breach affects nearly 1.2 million people
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, BleepingComputer, The Verge, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 41 articles published in the last 24 hours
